negative_evidence: Independent/coupled reward-generation alternatives are experimenter-defined candidate structures, not evidence of a universal internal generative model.
The model explicitly ignores dependencies across trials and the source says reward-structure learning ultimately must integrate temporal-dependency learning.
A nontrivial subset of choices is not captured by the compared models; fit does not establish neural implementation.
Q-learning with softmax is a comparator and must not be merged into the central model.
unresolved_issues: Temporal dependencies across trials are outside the central source model; behavioral fit is incomplete and does not identify neural implementation.

annotation: Bayesian RL/structure-learning traditions acknowledged; global genealogy independence not certified

preserved_noninferences: external trajectory/history cannot automatically become internal memory
prediction error cannot automatically become persistent coordinator state
learned parameter cannot automatically become active controller
model output cannot automatically become learned representation
complexity or poor fit cannot imply A2
no genealogy path/citation is not independence
